comment: The verbose control for the !verbose item-action recipes: a dwarvish Valkyrie takes off and wears her shield and un-readies her dagger. invent.c ddoinv() calls dispinv_with_action(), which hands the picked item to iactions.c itemactions(), whose itemactions_pushkeys() queues the command and the item letter, and invent.c getobj() takes the letter from cmdq_pop() without a prompt.
